Subject: Ground transport needs for Aug 24-25 workshop

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again — we are locking in logistics for our on-site workshop on Aug 24-25 at the Granite Financial training center. A few asks I want to run past you so you can provide a vendor proposal and rough cost: 

- VIP arrivals: CEO (Raj Mehra) now scheduled on AA312, ETA SFO 13:30 on Aug 24. We'd prefer a private sedan pick-up (meet-and-greet).
- Speakers: 4 external speakers arriving separately between 10:00–13:00; some will take rideshare, some need rental cars for local travel during the day.
- Attendees: ~48 in-person. We will need either one 24-pass shuttle split into two runs or two 12–14 passenger vans for morning site run (drop at venue from two hotels).
- Staff rentals: request 2 corporate rental cars for onsite staff (driver-not-required), plus one backup vehicle.
- Parking: venue requires parking permits for vendor vehicles and two overnight permits for speakers with early flights. They can be pre-purchased and left at the welcome desk.

Can you send: a) a concise vendor quote for sedan pick-up + shuttle/van options + rentals; b) a recommended schedule (pick-up windows); c) how we handle parking passes (valet vs self-park) and cost estimate.

We need a recommended plan by COB Aug 17 so procurement can approve payments. Attaching the preliminary attendee list (separate).

Thanks,
Susan

Subject: RE: Ground transport needs for Aug 24-25 workshop — vendor proposals and parking

Team / Susan — draft plan and quotes below. Attached: ground_transport_quotes.pdf, guest_shuttle_manifest.csv (blank filled), venue_parking_map.png.

High-level proposal (option A = lower cost, Option B = premium VIP service):

- VIP sedan (1x) + meet-and-greet (EliteLimo)
  - Option A: Black sedan, meet-and-greet, wait time 60m — $150 flat + $3.75/min wait after 15m.
  - Option B: Executive sedan with airport expedited lane + name-card meet — $220 flat.
  - EliteLimo ops contact: ops@elitelimo.com — can provide driver bio on request.

- Speaker rentals (Hertz corporate reservation)
  - Reserve 3 midsize (Toyota Camry class) for Aug 24–25, prepaid corporate rate $45/day per car incl. standard liability; one backup reserved but on-hold (no charge until pick-up).

- Attendee shuttle / van plan
  - Option 1 (recommended for traffic): 2x 14-pass Mercedes Sprinters — two round trips AM (7:30 and 8:30 hotels -> venue) and two PM return runs (16:45 and 18:00) — $950 per shuttle (flat for day, includes driver and tolls).
  - Option 2: Single 24-pass shuttle split into two runs — $1,200 flat.
  - We recommend Option 1 for flexibility and quicker turnaround.

- Parking and venue logistics
  - Venue sells day permits ($15/day) and overnight vendor permits ($30/night). We will procure 12 vendor/day permits + 2 overnight speaker permits = estimated $240 total.
  - Venue requires permits to be displayed in windshield; parking passes can be picked up at venue security the morning of event at 7:00am with a booking reference (we will provide).

Estimated cost (Option A overall):
  - EliteLimo sedan (Option A): $150
  - 3x Hertz rental (2 days): $270 total
  - 2x 14-pass shuttles: $1,900
  - Parking permits: $240
  - Contingency / gratuity (recommended): $200
  - Estimated total: $2,760

Timing / next steps:
  - Need Susan to confirm: hotel pickup addresses & VIP escort preference; approval on Option A vs B for sedan.
  - If approved, we ask DocuSign authorization for a vendor deposit (25% of shuttle cost for EliteLimo and shuttle ops) — link to be sent to Susan.
  - We will provide a filled guest_shuttle_manifest.csv once Susan confirms headcounts per hotel.

Notes / operational flags:
  - If flight delays occur we can request driver to wait; EliteLimo charges waiting per minute after 15 minutes — we recommend marking arrival buffer in manifest.
  - Valet recommended only if speakers require immediate elevator access; otherwise self-park with pre-purchased permits is simplest.

Let me know and I can push the vendor confirmations today.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Events Coordinator, Redwood Inference
